works.name: heild
works.role: author: identity, design system, site and demo
works.description: heild is old norse for the whole. it is a system that brings a company's tools into one place: a dashboard, a crm with whatsapp, a timesheet, finance, files and an app for the client. alongside them works a team of ai members, one for each area. the members prepare the work and a person approves it: transmitting, paying, signing and sending to the client always pass through an approval card that carries the name of whoever approved. it has not launched yet.

works.name: aφesis
works.role: author: the design system, the font, the mark and the site
works.description: aphes.ist is an experimental, hermetic personal site, and this is part of it. it is one document that never reloads: a stippled fog, a φ drawn by hand that travels between the center and the corner, typewriter text and a brush script for names. it holds a design system where nothing is solid, aphesis script, a variable font drawn with the φ's brush, and the engine that redraws the φ live and closes it into the seal in the corner.

sources.description: aphesis README.md (main branch) and the mark branch README

works.name: contraprova
works.role: author: the orchestrator, the pre-registered study and the replay
works.description: a governed orchestrator. a strong model plans from outlines, claude haiku does the narrow work, a gate checks each change, and only what the gate blocks escalates to a stronger model. every fact is an event in a hash-chained log; every claim is tied to a number registered before the run. on 88 fresh swe-bench pro tasks the cascade solved 83 and a single opus 85: −2.3 points [−8.0, +3.4], inside the pre-registered 10-point margin, at $0.055 per solved task against $0.139, about 61% less.

map.caption: the governed cascade · plan, work, gate, fork

works.name: anamnesis
works.role: author: the app, the brain and its evaluation; in progress
works.description: a local-first second brain, open source, that measures itself. notes, sources and conversations become a turning 3d stipple brain of linked dots, with regions that keep their names as it grows and every change an event in a hash-chained log. it works with no model, or with yours: a local one, an api key, or the subscriptions you already have. it asks one question of your own writing: what share of the links i later make by hand was already latent in what i had written? it is in progress.
